blocks.text: TURIN, Italy — Alexander Zverev suggested that he was pushing the two Grand Slam titles that he won this year down a notch in status when he was awarded another big trophy on Monday: the year-end No. 1 hardware. Tour chairman Andrea Gaudenzi presented Zverev with the huge silver cup at the ATP Finals. “Last year playing this tournament, I thought, ‘Yes, maybe I can win a Grand Slam, maybe I can do well during the year.’ But I didn’t even imagine that I could stand here holding this trophy,” Zverev said during the ceremony. “It’s the biggest achievement of my […]...
